research_question: Can RAKL distinguish corpus coverage, inspiration retrieval, structural analogy recognition, and target transfer on real cross-domain scientific material while measuring whether structural abstraction adds value beyond lexical/embedding baselines under matched model, task, evaluator, top-k, and resource contracts?

ground_truth_factorization.principle: Do not treat one benchmark label as authority for all similarity layers.

layers.label: RETRIEVAL_RELEVANCE
layers.meaning: The source is a benchmark-designated methodology inspiration or otherwise relevant retrieval target.

layers.label: STRUCTURAL_WITNESS_VALIDITY
layers.meaning: A separately evaluated typed mapping preserves the registered relations/invariants under a predeclared mapping and probe family.

layers.label: TRANSFER_UTILITY_OR_VALIDITY
layers.meaning: A predeclared target-domain test supports the specific inference/intervention transferred through the witness.
does_not_imply: mechanism identity beyond the tested scope

external_benchmark_manifests.verified_this_run: repository revision and artifact metadata pinned through GitHub
external_benchmark_manifests.authority_boundary: MIR gold inspiration labels are retrieval-relevance evidence only unless RAKL separately constructs and validates a typed structural witness.

external_benchmark_manifests.purpose: cross-domain isomorphic science problems separating reasoning from domain-knowledge retrieval
external_benchmark_manifests.authority_boundary: IsoSci structural isomorphism labels probe reasoning-versus-knowledge attribution; they are not paper-inspiration retrieval labels and are not merged with MIR into one score.

matched_route_contract.resource_rule: Resource/tool differences must be explicitly declared and costed. If resources differ, any gain is system-level or mixed-attribution evidence, not pure route/model-utilization amplification.
matched_route_contract.chronology_rule: Queries, abstraction prompts, route parameters, top-k, evaluator and labels must be frozen before outcome inspection.

hostile_worlds.condition: route trials name MIR but omit exact repository revision or artifact SHA
one route uses chronological test while another uses a different split
designated inspiration/source IDs are visible to query generation or retrieval
domain-stripped query is edited after inspecting gold sources
structural route receives larger top-k than lexical baseline without explicit normalization
one route uses a stronger base model/configuration
graph route uses an external graph/index while baseline resource set is reported as identical
graph route adds a declared graph/index and improves recall
MIR gold inspiration is retrieved but fails the predeclared structural witness probes
typed structural witness is valid but target-domain transfer test fails
high lexical overlap candidate outranks the gold/structural source but violates a decisive invariant
route increases disciplinary distance without improving valid-witness recall
the same candidate is returned by multiple routes
designated source is absent from the frozen candidate corpus
IsoSci-style isomorphic pair is solved only after domain knowledge retrieval
same model improves consistently across an isomorphic pair without resource delta under frozen conditions
a presentation/viewer layer fails or changes while pinned repository artifacts remain identifiable

acceptance_rule.support_implementation: May be promoted only if it merely validates benchmark identity/comparability and passes unchanged tests; it must not activate a retrieval route.
acceptance_rule.future_route_activation: A richer route can become default only after the real benchmark is actually executed, blocking invariants remain clean, and it improves at least one registered capability meta-QoI under matched or correctly attributed resource conditions.
acceptance_rule.null: If lexical+embedding matches richer routes on valid-witness recall, near-miss rejection, transfer utility and cost, keep the simpler baseline and preserve the null.
acceptance_rule.refuted: If RAKL structural abstraction increases false analogies or fails matched retrieval, retain counterexamples and do not promote it.
acceptance_rule.partial_id: If MIR supports retrieval relevance but not structural ground truth, report only retrieval performance there and obtain structural labels from a separate benchmark/probe process.
acceptance_rule.blocked: If exact corpus bytes/revision, hidden-label isolation, model identity, evaluator identity or route resources cannot be established, mark the affected trial CANNOT_CHECK.

promotion_rule: No active retrieval behavior is changed by this frozen benchmark.
